desc: This is the initial release of the Molecular Definition Implementation Guide for Molecular Data Types for initial ballot January 2027.
title: Molecular Definition Implementation Guide for Molecular Data Types
registry-description: The Molecular Definition Data Types Implementation Guide defines profiles of the MolecularDefinition resource (Sequence, Allele, Variation, Haplotype, Genotype) to represent genomic data types. It is developed by the HL7 Clinical Genomics Work Group.
introduction: The Molecular Definition Implementation Guide for Molecular Data Types defines the use of the MolecularDefinition resource to represent genomic data types.
